name: OMNIPHI FUTURES: Civic Prediction Exchange
description: OmniPhi Casino Network's licensed prediction exchange, allowing registered Tier 3–5 users to place wagers on verifiable civic outcomes: district crime-index shifts, corponation quarterly employment figures, water-ration adjustment dates, and gubernatorial appointment timelines. All positions are settled via the Meridian Civic Data Authority's official feeds, and BCI-integrated dashboards let players monitor live probability shifts while commuting, eating, or sleeping. The platform launched with aggressive corporate sponsorship from HelixCorp's data-analytics division, which also happens to supply several of the underlying data feeds.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 data analyst notices a pattern of impossible winning positions and begins quietly building a case — not realizing the positions belong to someone in the Spire who knows she's watching.
A Shelf community organizer gains illegal access to the exchange and uses prediction-market probabilities to warn residents about incoming enforcement actions before they happen.
The platform's AI arbitration system flags a legitimate winning position as fraudulent, freezing a Tier 4 player's life savings — and the appeals process leads straight into a HelixCorp black box.
